statement: The function returns a result r and r = min { |{v in D : count(v) - x_v > 0}| : for every v in D, x_v is an integer with 0 <= x_v <= count(v), and sum_{v in D} x_v = k }, where D is the set of distinct values occurring in arr and count(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, or overflow) for every arr and k satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= max(0, m - k), where m is the number of distinct values occurring in arr.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= m, where m is the number of distinct values occurring in arr.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= len(arr) - k.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever k = 0 and the function returns a result r, r = m, where m is the number of distinct values occurring in arr.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever k = len(arr) and the function returns a result r, r = 0.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever all elements of arr are equal (so the number of distinct values in arr is 1) and the function returns a result r, r = 1 if k < len(arr), and r = 0 if k = len(arr).
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever the values arr[i] are pairwise distinct (so the number of distinct values in arr equals len(arr)) and the function returns a result r, r = len(arr) - k.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Let r be the result returned by the function. There exist integers x_v, one for each distinct value v occurring in arr, such that 0 <= x_v <= count(v) for every v, sum_{v in D} x_v = k, and |{v in D : count(v) - x_v > 0}| = r, where D is the set of distinct values occurring in arr and count(v) is the number of indices i with arr[i] = v.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Let r be the result returned by the function. For every choice of integers x_v, one for each distinct value v occurring in arr, satisfying 0 <= x_v <= count(v) for every v and sum_{v in D} x_v = k, one has |{v in D : count(v) - x_v > 0}| >= r, where D is the set of distinct values occurring in arr and count(v) is the number of indices i with arr[i] = v.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Let f_1 <= f_2 <= ... <= f_m be the positive frequencies count(v) of the distinct values v occurring in arr, sorted in nondecreasing order, where m is the number of distinct values. Let q be the largest integer with 0 <= q <= m and sum_{i=1}^q f_i <= k, with the empty sum for q=0 equal to 0. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = m - q.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: For every k1 and k2 with 0 <= k1 <= k2 <= len(arr), if the function returns r1 when called on arr with k1 and returns r2 when called on arr with k2, then r2 <= r1.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and the statement quantifies only over k1 and k2 with 0 <= k1 <= k2 <= len(arr).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if k = len(arr).
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: Let D be the set of distinct values occurring in arr and let count(v) be the number of indices i with arr[i] = v. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = |D| if and only if k < min_{v in D} count(v).
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).

statement: If the function returns r on input arr with k and returns r2 on input arr2 with the same k, then r2 = r.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= k <= len(arr); and arr2 is any slice with len(arr2) = len(arr) such that for every value v, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr2) and arr2[i] = v equals the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v.

statement: Let n = len(arr) and let M = max_{v in D} count(v), where D is the set of distinct values occurring in arr and count(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 1 if and only if n - M <= k < n.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 10^9; and 0 <= k <= len(arr).
